3DWDecomp
=========

A matching decompilation of **Super Mario 3D World + Bowser's Fury** (Nintendo Switch, 1.0.0).
Each translation unit is rebuilt from C/C++ with the game's own compiler (Clang for NX 1.8.14)
and compared against the original code with [objdiff](https://github.com/encounter/objdiff).

Documentation
-------------

* [docs/ABOUT.md](docs/ABOUT.md) - what the project is and how it is organized
* [docs/getting_started.md](docs/getting_started.md) - toolchain, the build/diff loop, tools
* [docs/CONVENTIONS.md](docs/CONVENTIONS.md) - code style
* [docs/FUNCTIONS.md](docs/FUNCTIONS.md) - inlined and weak functions

Code documentation is generated with [Doxygen](https://www.doxygen.nl) into `doxygen/`
(open `doxygen/index.html`):

```sh
doxygen Doxyfile
```

Building
--------

```sh
python configure.py   # config/1.0.0/* -> build.ninja + objdiff.json
ninja                  # units that have source
ninja all              # every unit (needed for the progress report)
python tools/progress.py
```

Requirements: Python 3.10+ with `pyelftools`, `capstone`, `lz4`; ninja; the NintendoSDK
compiler in `tools/nnsdk/`; objdiff-cli in `tools/bin/`; `fury.nso` in the repository root.
On Linux/macOS the SDK compiler runs under wine.

Git hooks
---------

```sh
git config core.hooksPath tools/hooks
```

* `pre-commit` runs `tools/progress.py` and stages the updated README.md
  (skip once with `SKIP_PROGRESS=1 git commit ...`).
* `post-commit` regenerates the progress website (`site/index.html`, see below) and the
  Doxygen docs in the background (when `doxygen` is on PATH).

Website
-------

`python tools/website.py` turns `build/report.json` into a single static page,
`site/index.html` (inline CSS, a small night-mode script): overall and per-library progress,
and every file of every sub-library of Game, al/Library and al/Project (best first, scrollable). Upload the `site/`
folder as-is. The post-commit hook regenerates it after every commit.

To publish it automatically to https://shibbo.net/3dw/, copy `deploy.ini.example` to
`deploy.ini` (git-ignored) and fill in the host's SFTP/FTP details. From then on
`tools/deploy_site.py` uploads `site/` whenever it changed: after every commit (in the
background, log in `build/deploy.log`) and before every push (`pre-push` hook, which
also covers commits merged in from elsewhere). Run `python tools/deploy_site.py --force`
to upload by hand. SFTP needs `pip install paramiko`.
